entities.name: UniProt Q52424 AAC(2')
observations: Reviewed Providencia stuartii aminoglycoside 2′-N-acetyltransferase; query sequence is an exact full-length match (100% identity and coverage).
EC 2.3.1.59; catalyzes acetyl-CoA-dependent acetylation at aminoglycoside 2′ position, reported for a hydroxyl or amino group; confers aminoglycoside resistance.

entities.name: Aminoglycoside 2′ acetylation
observations: Example reaction: gentamicin C1a + acetyl-CoA → N(2′)-acetylgentamicin C1a + CoA + H⁺ (Rhea RHEA:24516).
The enzyme transfers an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to the aminoglycoside 2′ position.
